SELECT /*selectMasterWmGrStockVmiWareHousingProgressList*/ Y.TARGET, Y.PO_NO, Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, Y.DESCRIPTION, Y.MAKER_NAME, Y.PO_CREATE_DATE, Y.DS_DATE, Y.PO_QTY, Y.AGENT_PRICE, Y.AGENT, Y.STATUS, Y.INV_NO, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, Y.SPECIFICATION, Y.RD_DATE, Y.WMS_GR_DATE, Y.INV_QTY, Y.GI_GR_QTY, Y.ADD_USER_NAME, Y.ADD_USER_TEL, Y.POHD_REMARK, Y.MASTER_ITEM, Y.IMG_NO, Y.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, Y.CONTRACT_NO, Y.CONTRACT_SEQ, Y.DOC_TYPE, Y.AGENT_NAME, Y.AGENT_TEL_NO, Y.GUBUN, Y.LEGACY_PO_NO, Y.ADD_USER_ID, Y.PR_NO FROM(
SELECT /*+USE_NL(A GR)*/ A.TARGET, A.PO_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.MAKER_NAME, A.PO_CREATE_DATE, A.DS_DATE, A.PO_QTY, A.AGENT_PRICE, A.AGENT, DECODE(GR.ITEM_QTY, A.INV_QTY, '입고완료', DECODE(A.PO_QTY, A.INV_QTY, '입고예정', '분할입고예정')) AS STATUS, A.INV_NO, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.SPECIFICATION, A.RD_DATE, GR.GR_DATE AS WMS_GR_DATE, A.INV_QTY, (SELECT SUM(NVL(SUB_GR.ITEM_QTY, 0)) FROM ICOMGRDT SUB_GR WHERE A.BUYER = SUB_GR.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = SUB_GR.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = SUB_GR.PO_SEQ AND SUB_GR.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY SUB_GR.BUYER, SUB_GR.PO_NO, SUB_GR.PO_SEQ ) AS GI_GR_QTY, A.ADD_USER_NAME, A.ADD_USER_TEL, A.POHD_REMARK, A.MASTER_ITEM, A.IMG_NO, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.DOC_TYPE, A.AGENT_NAME, A.AGENT_TEL_NO, A.GUBUN, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.PR_NO FROM ICOMGRDT GR, (SELECT /*+LEADING(PODT)*/ DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, '1', '재고', '3', 'VMI', '2', '재고') AS TARGET, PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.MAKER_NAME, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE, PODT.DS_DATE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, PODT.AGENT_PRICE, POHD.AGENT, IVDT.INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.SPECIFICATION, PODT.RD_DATE, IVDT.INV_QTY, IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.PO_REMARK AS POHD_REMARK, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, 1, 7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE, 'X', (SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO), '0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)) , '') AS IMG_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, POHD.DOC_TYPE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, 'STCK' AS GUBUN , PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, POHD.ADD_USER_ID, PODT.PR_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PRDT.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D'
AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1') AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code}
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%')
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_inv_no}||'%'
AND POHD.AGENT LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_code}||'%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_stdcatlg_id}||'%'
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+LEADING(PODT)*/ DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','3','VMI','2','재고') AS TARGET, PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.MAKER_NAME, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE, PODT.DS_DATE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, PODT.AGENT_PRICE, POHD.AGENT, WMS.INV_NO, WMS.INV_SEQ, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.SPECIFICATION, PODT.RD_DATE, WMS.INV_QTY, IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.PO_REMARK AS POHD_REMARK, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, 1, 7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE, 'X', (SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO), '0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)) , '') AS IMG_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, POHD.DOC_TYPE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, 'STCK' AS GUBUN , PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, POHD.ADD_USER_ID, PODT.PR_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, WMSIVDT WMS WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PRDT.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = WMS.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.INV_NO = WMS.S_INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = WMS.S_INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS <> 'D'
AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('2') AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code}
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%')
AND WMS.INV_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_inv_no}||'%'
AND POHD.AGENT LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_code}||'%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_stdcatlg_id}||'%'
) A WHERE GR.BUYER(+) = A.BUYER AND GR.PO_NO(+) = A.PO_NO AND GR.PO_SEQ(+) = A.PO_SEQ AND GR.BUYER(+) = A.BUYER AND GR.INV_NO(+) = A.INV_NO AND GR.INV_SEQ(+) = A.INV_SEQ AND GR.STATUS(+) <> 'D'
AND (NVL(GR.ITEM_QTY,0) != A.INV_QTY AND A.INV_QTY > 0)
AND (NVL(GR.ITEM_QTY,0) != A.INV_QTY AND A.PO_QTY != A.INV_QTY)
AND NVL(GR.ITEM_QTY,0) = A.INV_QTY
AND A.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND GR.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+LEADING(PODT)*/ DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, '1', '재고', '3', 'VMI', '2', '재고') AS TARGET, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.MAKER_NAME, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE, PODT.DS_DATE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, PODT.AGENT_PRICE, POHD.AGENT, '발주' AS STATUS, '' AS INV_NO, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.SPECIFICATION, PODT.RD_DATE, '' AS WMS_GR_DATE, 0 AS INV_QTY, (SELECT SUM(NVL(ITEM_QTY, 0)) FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE PODT.BUYER = BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS GI_GR_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.PO_REMARK AS POHD_REMARK, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, 1, 7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE, 'X', (SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO), '0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)) , '') AS IMG_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, POHD.DOC_TYPE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, 'STCK' AS GUBUN, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, POHD.ADD_USER_ID, PODT.PR_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PODT.PR_NO AND PRDT.PR_SEQ = PODT.PR_SEQ AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.IV_QTY <> PODT.ITEM_QTY AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code}
AND PODT.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date } AND #{st_to_date}
AND '1' <> #{st_from_date } ||#{st_to_date}
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%')
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_po_no}||'%'
AND POHD.AGENT LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_code}||'%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_stdcatlg_id}||'%'
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+INDEX(EDI EDIVPODT_PK)*/ 'VMI' AS TARGET, EDI.VPO_NO AS PO_NO, EDI.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, EDI.DESCRIPTION, EDI.MAKER_NAME, EDI.VPO_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, EDI.RD_DATE AS DS_DATE, EDI.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, EDI.UNIT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, EDI.AGENT, DECODE(EDI.RECV_FLAG,'A','권고발주','B','입고예정','C','입고완료') AS STATUS, EDI.VPO_NO AS INV_NO, EDI.UNIT_MEASURE, EDI.SPECIFICATION, EDI.RD_DATE, EDI.VGR_DATE AS WMS_GR_DATE, EDI.GR_QTY INV_QTY, 0 AS GI_GR_QTY, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = EDI.POK_USER_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS ADD_USER_NAME, (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = EDI.POK_USER_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS ADD_USER_TEL, '' AS POHD_REMARK, SUBSTR(EDI.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, (SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(EDI.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)) AS IMG_NO, (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=EDI.BUYER) AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, EDI.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, EDI.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, 'V' AS DOC_TYPE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=EDI.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = EDI.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, 'VMI' AS GUBUN, '' AS LEGACY_PO_NO, POK_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, '' AS PR_NO FROM EDIVPODT EDI WHERE EDI.BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code} AND EDI.STATUS <> 'D'
AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(VPO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')+2,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_from_date } AND #{st_to_date}
AND VGR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date } AND #{st_to_date}
AND EDI.VPO_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_po_no}||'%'
AND EDI.VPO_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_inv_no}||'%'
AND EDI.AGENT LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_code}||'%'
AND EDI.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_stdcatlg_id}||'%'
AND EDI.RECV_FLAG = 'A'
AND EDI.RECV_FLAG = 'B'
AND EDI.RECV_FLAG = 'F'
AND EDI.RECV_FLAG = 'C'
ORDER BY RD_DATE DESC, LEGACY_PO_NO DESC, PO_NO DESC, INV_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY AGENT_NAME, LEGACY_PO_NO DESC, PO_NO DESC, INV_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY PO_NO DESC, LEGACY_PO_NO DESC, INV_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY INV_NO, LEGACY_PO_NO DESC ,PO_NO DESC, INV_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY BUYER_ITEM_NO, LEGACY_PO_NO DESC, PO_NO DESC, INV_NO, DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, LEGACY_PO_NO DESC, PO_NO DESC, INV_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO
) Y
